assumptions: One feature-scoped measure record per measure kind (XDL1-UNIT/kind unit, XDL1-INTEGRATION/kind integration, XDL1-VALIDATION/kind validation, XDL1-STATIC/kind static_analysis) preserves the historical protected measure records under engineering/verification/measures/**; the trusted host policy binds the unit/static_analysis/integration/validation executions to these four new identities, and this candidate cannot inspect or edit that external policy.

The XDL1-UNIT record's 121 test_ids are exactly the unit_cases of the 19 current XDL1-SR-0nn-U unit records (verified by set equality in this stage); the predecessor's 102 identifiers are preserved verbatim and 19 successor identifiers are added. The XDL1-VALIDATION record's 18 test_ids are exactly the union of the seven XDL1-VS scenario test_ids (verified equal); the XDL1-STATIC record's 19 test_ids are exactly the declared XDL1-SR-0nn-U-STATIC static checks; the XDL1-INTEGRATION record's 8 test_ids are the reviewed predecessor set, unchanged because no finding concerned integration.

The 8 integration cases run through the real admitted loader/schema registry/semantics/normalizer, derived catalog, lifecycle-plan and C++ X-COM activation-plan consumers plus the additive CLI on real repository fixtures; mocks alone cannot satisfy the measure. Whole-system integration is defined only by the trusted policy system_integration contract over the pinned platform revision; the candidate-local pytest descriptors in the records are not integration evidence.

The static_analysis measure carries no pytest discovery, so the 19 identifiers are declaration-bound static rules (python ast parse of the additive compiler, JSON Schema 2020-12 meta-schema validation of the admitted payload schema, additive-diff scope check) rather than collected tests; no static analysis executes in this stage.

XDL1-VS-07 is the validation-level closure of XDL1-RVW-001/002/003: per-payload, total compiled-parameter and declared-core parameter bound negatives, a limitation-count negative, a boundary positive case and the System core-parameter projection positive case. Its five bound test_ids and one projection test_id are a subset of XDL1-VALIDATION.test_ids, and every scenario test_id is a subset of that measure's test_ids.

implemented_by cannot be traced before code exists because the trusted code_endpoint contract resolves a real file and binds its SHA-256 as the code-endpoint revision; the exact planned endpoints are recorded in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/planned-trace.json for the implementation stage, which owns adding them with exact hashes.

engineering/trace/links.json is a mutable additive trace file; this stage appended 183 verified_by/analyzed_by/validates links by textual insertion before the array close, so the file is not listed as an immutable artifact of this stage.

All admitted-input SHA-256 values and the predecessor-review evidence were re-verified in this stage (manifest vs review reviewed_files 2852/2852 identical; 122/122 retained rejected revisions re-hash to their manifest values). All scientific protocol values remain caller inputs and no thesis threshold, tolerance, deadline, repetition or seed appears in any measure, scenario or expectation.

No source, schema, fixture or test code was written; the precode gate requires the four design stages to complete before implementation, and the integration/validation test modules named by this plan are created by the implementation stage.
findings: XDL1-RVW-003 closure at the verification-design level (planned evidence, not executed): the missing count-bound negatives are now bound to exact identifiers in TWO measures. XDL1-UNIT carries 15 count-based bound cases in XDL1-SR-019-U (per-payload, total compiled and declared-core max_parameters scopes, plus max_steps, max_faults, max_observers, max_metrics, max_dependencies_per_step, max_flows, max_bindings, max_resources, max_text_length, max_diagnostics) and 1 limitation-count negative in XDL1-SR-012-U; XDL1-VALIDATION carries XDL1-VS-07 with test_per_payload_parameter_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan, test_total_compiled_parameter_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan, test_declared_core_parameter_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan, test_declared_limitation_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan and the boundary case test_parameter_counts_at_declared_bounds_compile_resolved_plan. XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED is therefore no longer an untested frozen diagnostic code in the frozen contract; satisfaction still requires the successor's own executed measures, owned by later stages and not claimed here.

XDL1-RVW-001 and XDL1-RVW-002 bindings carried into this plan: the total compiled-parameter scope (detailed-design.md section 10.3 scope 2, XDL1-DD-13) is bound by XDL1-SR-019-U::test_max_parameters_total_compiled_scope_exceeded_rejected and by XDL1-VS-07::test_total_compiled_parameter_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan, whose per-payload lists are each within the bound while the total exceeds it; the System core-parameter projection (XDL1-DD-14) is bound by the three XDL1-SR-002-U projection cases and by XDL1-VS-07::test_system_core_parameters_projected_without_drop_or_duplication. These are planned bindings, not evidence that the behaviour exists.
